       1 # BOS-869 — Decide whether the TUI detach path should stop clobbering a user rename with a derived title
       3 ## Summary
       5 `AttachModel.updateChatTitle` (`services/boss/internal/views/attach.go:611-644`) runs on chat exit and detach. It re-derives a title from the agent transcript's first user message and writes it throu
         gh the deliberately-unguarded `UpdateChatTitle` RPC without ever looking at the title already stored, so a chat the user renamed is renamed back on every detach. The decision this ticket asks for: **
         .
       7 ## Approach
       9 - **Guard the detach write; do not keep the behaviour and do not add a source marker.** BOS-611 already ratified that a first-user-message-derived title is non-authoritative (`Explicit: false`) and m
         ust not replace a non-placeholder title. The detach writer is the one place that settled rule goes unenforced, so "keep it and document why" is not defensible. A per-title source marker needs a schem
      10 - **Read the stored title fresh at detach, inside the closure, immediately before the write** — `m.client.ListChats(m.ctx, m.sessionID)`, matched on `m.agentSessionID`. The rejected alternative is ca
         pane can rename its own chat through the MCP `update_chat_title` tool, and `boss chat rename` and the web UI run from a second terminal. Renaming while attached is a normal path, not a race.
